Week 33 Module Map: Post-War Texas

Quarter 4: Convergence and Divergence · Geography pass: air conditioning and the Sunbelt

Texas reaches its closest alignment with the nation at mid-century. A Sunbelt boom comes from a machine, and Texas faces the fact that a changing economy does not change an old order on its own.

Your lessons this week

  • Lesson 1: The Sunbelt Boom
  • Lesson 2: Civil Rights and the Americanization of Texas

What to turn in

  • Reading quiz: Week 33 Reading Quiz
  • Primary source assessment: Week 33 Primary Source Assessment
  • VR write-up: Week 33 VR Write-Up, based on your immersive session

Keep going all quarter

Read each lesson all the way through before you start the quiz. The read-aloud player at the top of each lesson can help you follow along, and the speaker button next to each vocabulary word plays its pronunciation.

Something to watch for

Courage and service: notice them in Heman Sweatt, Hector P. García, Pete Hernández, Barbara Jordan, and Oveta Culp Hobby.
